verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Funnels report that measures conversion through a series of events, and its site describes finding critical drop-off points. It says interactive reports can be built with a few clicks, and Session Replay lets you follow up on why users drop off. Natural-language funnel queries via MCP further lower the analyst barrier. A community comment that PMs quickly build custom report after custom report corroborates self-serve use, and Flows is praised for user-journey insight, though its hover-based UI drew usability complaints. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of per-step drop-off breakdowns (time-to-convert, segmenting drop-off by property), and hands-on evidence of a non-analyst founder running activation funnels specifically.
